items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Right, right' to the interviewer's statement about Pops Foster; no personal interaction or relationship is described.

ctx.x: Right, right. And they're proud of each other, and they -- when they come away from there, I've had some musicians work with me and every year they have to make a trip back down there, and then they come back and tell you how well everybody's doing. It's just great.

Yeah. I had heard a tape, Pops Foster and Louis Armstrong talking, and I heard it down in New Orleans, New Orleans Jazz Museum. And Louis said the problem with most of the guys from New Orleans was that they always pine to go home again, and they'd go home....
